[Bug]: Can not subset using `tuple()`
### Describe the bug

[Docs say](https://narwhals-dev.github.io/narwhals/api-reference/dataframe/#narwhals.dataframe.DataFrame.__getitem) you can subset using a `Sequence`. This should support `tuple()`, not just `list()`

### Steps or code to reproduce the bug

```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl

DATA={ "x": [1,2,3] }
pd_df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(DATA), eager_only=True)
pl_df = nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame(DATA), eager_only=True)

print("nw tuple subset")

print("list, list ; √")
print("tuple, list ; X")
print("list, tuple ; X")
print("tuple, tuple ; X")
